params.name: webhookId
params.description: The unique identifier for the webhook-triggered workflow.

items.docs: Triggers a workflow run by sending an HTTP POST request to the workflow's unique webhook endpoint. The workflow is started immediately when a valid HTTP request is received. A relayDeduplicationKey can be provided to ensure each unique workflow is only triggered once per key.
